title: Bulb lifetimes: exponential with mean 1,000 h
caption: The rate is 1/1,000 per hour, so P(lasts > 1,500) = e⁻¹·⁵ = 0.2231 (the shaded tail). The median is 1,000 ln 2 ≈ 693 hours.
alt: Exponential density with mean 1,000 hours, decaying from 0.001; the tail beyond 1,500 hours is shaded, area 0.2231.
description: The density starts at the rate λ = 0.001 and decays.
The shaded tail beyond 1,500 hours has area e⁻¹·⁵ = 0.2231.
